title.en: Street Racing: Original Sports Car in an Original Seaside City

view.en: Third-person view behind an original sports car. Speed and rev gauges are at the bottom; the top shows how far the event has come, rival gap or bust meter. Edge arrows point to rivals and police cars that are off screen

goal.en: Each event has its own win: finish the route, beat the rival, score a higher total, avoid finishing last, or escape the police. Running out of time, a rival finishing first, being caught or a wrecked car loses; each run lasts at most 300 seconds and a timeout is not a win. Nothing recovers by itself

mouse.en: This game does not use the mouse

keys.en: steer left (the longer held, the more angle; less angle at high speed; in drag races, change to the left lane)
steer right (in drag races, change to the right lane)
slow motion on / off (the world slows and downforce rises)
shift up (manual gearbox in drag races)
shift down (manual gearbox in drag races)
reset onto the route; for about 2 s afterwards (flashing) the police catch you more easily

notes.en: A / D must be held for a while to wind the wheel on, and it eases back when released; at higher speed the angle is smaller.
Drag races use a manual gearbox: press K when the rev gauge reaches the green zone. A / D change lanes there instead of steering.
Nitrous is limited and takes time to recover. In toll and speed-trap events it pays most just before the key points.
Slow motion slows the world and adds downforce, which helps in tight corners; it drains with use, and J turns it off.
Walls and crashes scrub speed; staying on the route is usually fastest, and a reset costs time.

steer.en: Steering as a duty cycle over the 6 sub-steps (no mouse)

options.none: no steering, wheel returns to centre
options.left_tap: tap left (drag: change to the left lane)
options.left_ease: left for 2 of 6 sub-steps: wheel slowly returns
options.left_hold: left for 3 of 6: keep the current angle
options.left_hold_late: left for 3 of 6, offset half a beat: keep the angle
options.left_more: left for 4 of 6: wind more angle on
options.right_tap: tap right (drag: change to the right lane)
options.right_ease: right for 2 of 6 sub-steps: wheel slowly returns
options.right_hold: right for 3 of 6: keep the current angle
options.right_hold_late: right for 3 of 6, offset half a beat: keep the angle
options.right_more: right for 4 of 6: wind more angle on

press.en: Gear shift, slow motion, reset, handbrake

summary.en: A solo run along the coast road through toll gates; each gate adds time, and you lose when the clock runs out. Traffic is on the road

tell.en: A gate and light beam on the road ahead

effect.en: Passing adds time to the clock; clearing the last gate wins

counter.en: Keep speed on the ideal line and use nitrous to gain time

tell.en: Civilian cars driving slowly on the road ahead

effect.en: A crash scrubs a lot of speed or stops you

counter.en: Move to the clear side early; do not force an overtake in a corner

summary.en: Several drag races in a row against one rival on a straight four-lane strip. The car holds its line by itself; you change lanes and handle throttle, nitrous and gears

tell.en: The rev needle during the countdown

effect.en: Launching with revs in the target band gives a boost; too high spins the clutch

counter.en: Hold the throttle during the countdown and keep revs a little below the redline

tell.en: The rev gauge enters the green zone

effect.en: A well-timed upshift gives a bonus; sitting on the limiter builds heat and a blown engine loses

counter.en: Press K as soon as the gauge is in the green; do not sit on the limiter

tell.en: Blue flame behind the rival's car

effect.en: The rival speeds up for a while and gains ground

counter.en: Use your own nitrous at a good moment

tell.en: Traffic or an obstacle appears in your lane

effect.en: A hard hit at high speed drops too much speed and wrecks the car, losing the heat

counter.en: Change lanes early with A / D

summary.en: Drive through speed cameras along the coast road; the speeds at each camera add up and are compared with one rival. Cameras sit where speed is easiest to reach

tell.en: A roadside camera and gate; a light beam marks the next one

effect.en: Records your speed as you pass and adds it to your total

counter.en: Start nitrous 1 to 3 seconds before a camera and do not brake before it

tell.en: Blue flame behind the rival as it nears a camera

effect.en: The rival posts a higher speed at the camera and widens the gap

counter.en: Save nitrous for the cameras; you lose if the margin runs out

tell.en: Civilian cars on the road

effect.en: A crash cuts speed and so the reading at that camera

counter.en: Change lanes early and do not get stuck behind a car before a camera

summary.en: A night-time downtown circuit with several rivals; the last car over the line each lap is knocked out and you must not be last. You start on the back row

tell.en: After cars finish the lap, the last rival disappears

effect.en: Finishing last means you lose

counter.en: Pass at least one rival every lap and do not lose speed in corners

tell.en: Other cars driving the route ahead; the further forward, the faster

effect.en: They do not yield and nudge aside on contact; once far ahead they are hard to catch

counter.en: Take the inside line, get on the throttle early out of corners and use nitrous to catch up

tell.en: A few civilian cars on the circuit

effect.en: A crash scrubs speed and drops you to the back

counter.en: Steer around them as soon as you see them

summary.en: Free roam in the city: first raise a bounty, then lose the police; each cleared stage raises the heat and brings stronger police. You lose when the bust meter fills

tell.en: Police cars behind or beside you with flashing lights

effect.en: When a cop is close and you are slow, the bust meter fills and you lose

counter.en: Keep speed high and open a gap; stay out of sight to build the escape

tell.en: A cop closes beside your rear, a red warning bar appears and the mirror frame turns red

effect.en: The hit spins you and bleeds speed

counter.en: Accelerate away on the warning, or steer outwards

tell.en: Police cars blocking the road ahead, with a distance warning bar at the bottom

effect.en: Hitting it slows you a lot, and its cops then join the chase

counter.en: Aim for the gap

tell.en: A spike strip on the road, with a warning bar at the bottom

effect.en: Tyres are punctured and burst after about half a second; grip drops sharply

counter.en: Change lane early to avoid it

tell.en: A roadside structure that can be knocked down

effect.en: When knocked down it lands on cops behind you

counter.en: Speed past it so the cops follow into its collapse

tell.en: A helicopter and spotlight overhead

effect.en: It sees far, so hiding behind buildings is harder

counter.en: Keep moving fast until it runs out of fuel and leaves

phases.en: Each escape raises the heat: more and faster police cars

summary.en: A race through city streets against the street champion while police chase you too. You lose if the rival reaches the end first or you are caught

tell.en: Blue flame behind the rival's car

effect.en: It speeds up noticeably for a while and pulls ahead

counter.en: Use your own nitrous and take a shorter line to catch up

tell.en: Police cars behind or beside you with flashing lights

effect.en: The bust meter fills when a cop is close; full means loss

counter.en: Keep speed up, avoid walls and keep moving forward

tell.en: Police cars blocking the road or a spike strip, with a warning bar at the bottom

effect.en: Hitting them slows you or bursts a tyre, letting the rival catch up

counter.en: Change lane early to go around
